quotes.text: I would highly recommend the Marina to anyone! I'm a huge fan of the services offered and the experience as a whole. The owners are fabulous to work with- super accommodating and made the day that much better. Thanks so much for everything!!
The staff got us what we needed and then figured out how to make it cheaper and more efficient when our party got smaller. They were very attentive to our requests and pleasure to deal with.

quotes.text: This is the marina you overlook if you dine at bentwood tavern. Very pretty, lots of very nice boats. Walkable from new buffalo beach.
